grass-rustle: Something small moving slowly through long dry grass in a quiet garden, a soft dry rustle that stops, then stillness and a faint breeze, no voices, no music, no hiss
evening-wind-trees: The evening breeze in a great garden: a long slow wave of wind rising through tall trees, leaves rushing and turning, then settling back into quiet, no footsteps, no voices, no music, no whoosh effect
dusk-hush: Deep quiet among trees at dusk, very soft leaves barely moving, the last evening birds falling silent, near stillness, no voices, no music
heavy-sky-wind: Wind over long grass under a heavy evening sky, low gusts, very distant soft thunder far away, sorrowful and quiet, no rain, no voices, no music
turning-flame: A large ring of fire turning slowly in the open air at dusk, a steady low roar with soft crackling and a slow rhythmic sweep as it turns, calm not explosive, no voices, no music
torn-cloth: A great heavy woven curtain tearing slowly from top to bottom in a tall stone hall, a long deep rip, then a soft swell of moving air and quiet, no voices, no music, no crash
